documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the document's canonical JSON.

occurrences.description: Occurrences, sorted by `occurrence` in code point order.

nets.description: System nets, sorted by `id` in code point order.

mates.description: B2B mappings, sorted by `mate` in code point order.

links.description: Harness link wirings, sorted by `harness` then `link`, in code point order.

splices.description: Proposed splices, sorted by `harness`, `end` then `pad` (natural order).

harnesses.description:
Harness blocks with their resolved wire lists, in document order (§16.3).
Absent from a bundle built before format 5, such as an entry published
earlier; every build writes it.

suggestions.description: Sub-port suggestions, sorted by `occurrence`, `connector` then `key`, in code point order.

findings.description: Findings, sorted by `code` then `subject`, in code point order.

placement.description: Where each occurrence sits, and what each mate means for that (stage 3a).

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest: exactly 64 characters, no prefix such as `sha256:`.

state.description: What the build knew about it.

revisionKey.description: The revision key it was read at; absent unless `ready`.

bundleKey.description: The design bundle read; absent unless `ready`.

outline.description: The board outline's bounding box; absent unless `ready` with an Edge.Cuts outline.

connectors.description: Connectors in natural order of their reference; empty unless `ready`.

id.description: The net's id: stable while its pins are.

name.description: The display name: the most common non-automatic board net name.

names.description: Every distinct board net name, in code point order.

boardNets.description: Board nets, sorted by `occurrence` then `net`, in code point order.

pins.description: Pins, sorted by `occurrence` and `connector` in code point order, then `pad` in natural order.

SystemBundleNet.description: One system net: board nets joined through the system's connections.

pairs.description: Pin pairs, sorted by `a` in natural order.

unmappedA.description: Side A pads without a partner, in natural order.

unmappedB.description: Side B pads without a partner, in natural order.

pads.description: Both connectors' pads in the mated pose; absent when the geometry cannot decide it (stage 3c).

wires.description: Wires, sorted by `a` in natural order.

unmappedA.description: Side A pins left unmapped, in natural order.

unmappedB.description: Side B pins left unmapped, in natural order.

links.description: The links that wire it, in code point order.

SystemBundleSplice.description: A pin of one mating site that two links wire: a proposed splice.

wires.description: Explicit wires in document order, then each link's default wires.

route.description:
The route in 3D (stage 4c, §16.6). Absent in bundles built before
format 6, and when fewer than two ends are posed.

SystemBundleHarness.description: A harness block's ends and resolved wire list (§16.3).

key.description: The stable key a sub-port or dismissal names.

pins.description: Pads in natural order, at least two.

SystemBundleSuggestion.description: A sub-port suggestion read from a board's design bundle.

subject.description: The stable subject key a waiver names, for example `mate:mate_x`.

objects.description: Document object ids involved, in code point order.

waived.description: Whether a waiver of the document covers it.

occurrences.description: Every occurrence, sorted by `occurrence` in code point order.

mates.description: Every mate, sorted by `mate` in code point order.

exports.description:
Every export whose connector has footprint geometry and a place, sorted
by `export` in code point order (stage 3d). Absent in bundles built
before format 4.

SystemBundleObjectId.description: Id of an object in the system document (`prism.system.v2`).

SystemBundleOccurrenceState.description: What the build knew about an occurrence.

mpn.description: The manufacturer part number; absent when unknown.

candidate.description: Whether connector detection marks it a connector.

placement.description: Where it sits on the board; absent when the board has no outline.

pins.description: Pins in natural order of their pad.

SystemBundleConnector.description: One connector of a board occurrence.

SystemBundleNetId.description: A system net's id: `net-` and 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

NetName.description:
KiCad full net name as KiCad resolves it, including the sheet path prefix
of a local net (`/Power/VBUS`), a global name (`GND`) or a generated name
(`Net-(R1-Pad2)`, `unconnected-(U1-PA0-Pad3)`). "No net" is expressed by
omitting the field, never by an empty name.

SystemBundleBoardNet.description: A board net that is part of a system net.

SystemBundlePinRef.description: A connector pin of the system.

SystemBundleMateSource.description: Where a B2B mapping came from.

SystemBundlePadPair.description: One pin pair of a B2B mapping.

PadNumber.description:
Pad or pin number as written in the file, always a string (`1`, `A1`,
`EP`). Empty for a pad KiCad leaves unnumbered, such as a mechanical
non-plated hole.

a.description: Side A's named pads, in natural order of their pad; pads sharing a number each appear.

b.description: Side B's named pads, carried into A's frame by the mate transform, in natural order of their pad.

SystemBundleMatePads.description: Both connectors' pads in the mated pose, seen in side A's connector frame (x, y on the mating face, looking down its mating axis).

suggested.description: Whether it joins power or ground pins, shown as suggested until confirmed.

SystemBundleWire.description: One wire of a harness link's wiring.

occurrence.description: Its site's occurrence, when it has a site.

connector.description: Its site's connector, when it has a site.

housing.description: The resolved housing part (`componentId@revisionId`), when one is chosen.

cavities.description: Cavities in use, in natural order.

SystemBundleHarnessEnd.description: An end of a harness block and the cavities in use (§16.3).

id.description: The document wire's id, or `<link>:<pad A>` for a default wire.

net.description: The system net it is on.

routeLengthNm.description: Its route length (stage 4c, §16.6): segments' arc length, both housings' depths and the allowance.

derived.description: The tree was derived (no stored segments, or stored ones that are not a tree).

ends.description: The posed ends, in document order.

wires.description: Every wire of the wire list, in its order.

Refdes.description:
Reference designator as KiCad resolves it for one symbol instance or
footprint, for example `R1`, `U3`, `#PWR01` or `R?`. Always a string. A
contract states whether it includes virtual (`#`) and unannotated (`?`)
references.

SystemBundleSuggestionSource.description: Where a sub-port suggestion came from.

DiagnosticCode.description:
Stable machine-readable code of a finding, in lowercase kebab-case, for
example `stale-saved-fills` or `net-mismatch`. A code never changes meaning
once published; a new meaning gets a new code.

SystemBundleSeverity.description: A finding's fixed severity: errors block publishing an in-house entry unless waived.

pose.description: Its board frame in the system frame.

root.description: The occurrence is its mated group's root, or is not mated.

positioningMate.description: The mate that placed it, for a mated non-root.

bounds.description: Its board's outline box across its thickness, in its own frame; absent when unknown.

SystemBundlePlacedOccurrence.description: One occurrence's place in the system.

driving.description: It places one of its occurrences (it is a positioning mate).

stackHeightNm.description: The stack height used; absent when the mate could not be solved.

frameA.description: Side A's connector frame in the system frame; absent when unknown.

frameB.description: Side B's connector frame in the system frame; absent when unknown.

miss.description: A non-driving mate's miss: B's connector origin minus its mated position, on A's connector axes.

missDeg.description: A non-driving mate's rotation miss, in degrees.

SystemBundlePlacedMate.description: What one B2B mate means for placement.

mount.description:
The frame `geometry` is in, placed in the system frame with the
connector's side of its board applied, so the geometry reads at zero
thickness: a board's frame lifted to its surface, a body connector's
footprint frame.

geometry.description: The connector's footprint geometry in that frame.

matesTop.description: An unsure mating-axis inference mates out of the top face: a body's connector, or an export of one.

SystemBundlePlacedExport.description: One export's connector, as a system placing this one as an entry mates by it (stage 3d).

NonNegativeNanometres.description: A Nanometres value that is never negative: a thickness, width, diameter or length.

angleDeg.description: Angle from the outline's centre to the component, counter-clockwise from +x with +y up, in [0, 360).

side.description: The side it is mounted on.

SystemBundleConnectorPlacement.description: Where a connector sits on its board, for the schematic's default pin placement.

net.description: The pin's first schematic net; absent when it has none.

nets.description: Every schematic net the pin carries, in code point order.

pinName.description: The pin's first name; absent when it has none.

pinType.description: The pin's first electrical type; absent when unknown.

power.description: Whether the pin is on a power net.

SystemBundlePin.description: One pin of a connector, as the board's design bundle has it.

xNm.description: The centre's x in A's connector frame.

yNm.description: The centre's y in A's connector frame.

angleDeg.description: The pad's long axis, degrees counter-clockwise from A's +x, in [0, 180).

SystemBundleMatePad.description: One pad of a mate drawn in side A's connector frame (stage 3c).

SystemBundleWireRule.description: Which rule wired a pin pair of a harness link.

cavity.description: The cavity, as the end's `pinMap` names it.

net.description: The system net of that pad, when it has one.

contact.description: The resolved contact part (`componentId@revisionId`), when one is chosen.

SystemBundleHarnessCavity.description: A cavity of an end in use (§16.3).

SystemBundleWireOrigin.description: Where a wire of the wire list comes from.

pad.description: The site's pad in that cavity (`contact`, when the end has a site).

SystemBundleTerminal.description: One end of a wire of the wire list.

Nanometres.description:
Length or coordinate in integer nanometres, KiCad's internal board unit.
Converted from the file's decimal millimetres as KiCad's own parser does:
the double product value_mm * 1e6, rounded half away from zero. A single
coordinate or dimension fits KiCad's 32-bit range; sums (for example a
net's total track length) may not, hence a safe integer (|n| < 2^53).

exit.description: The housing's rear face, where the cable leaves it.

leg.description: The end of the straight boot, where the curve starts.

SystemBundleRouteEnd.description: A posed harness end (§16.6): where the cable leaves the housing.

id.description: The stored segment's id, or `<harness>/<from>~<to>` for a derived one.

derived.description: The tree was derived, not stored.

from.description: A node id: an end, a branch point, or `auto` for the automatic breakout.

wires.description: The wires it carries (wire-list ids, `<link>:<pad A>` for a default one), in wire-list order.

assumedGauge.description: A carried wire's gauge was missing or unknown, so 24 AWG's diameter was used.

samplesNm.description: The curve's samples as flat `[x, y, z, …]` triples in system space, in order from `from` to `to`.

minRadiusNm.description: The tightest bend's radius; absent for a straight segment.

minRadiusAllowedNm.description: The minimum bend radius, 6 × the diameter.

tightBend.description: Present when a bend is tighter than allowed.

clearances.description: Boards and bodies the bundle comes too close to, in occurrence order.

SystemBundleRouteSegment.description: One segment of the route tree and its curve (§16.6).

lengthNm.description: Absent when the wire is unrouted (a splice or loose terminal, or an unposed end).

SystemBundlePose.description: A frame in the system frame: translation, then rotation.

SystemBundlePoseSource.description: Where an occurrence's pose came from (CONTRACTS §8.9).

SystemBundleBounds.description: An axis-aligned box in an occurrence's own frame.

SystemBundleHeightSource.description: Which stack height a mate used.

SystemBundleVectorNm.description: A point or offset in the system frame, in nanometres.

Degrees.description:
Angle in degrees. In new documents it is as written in the KiCad file:
not normalized, not rounded. A parity document may round it as today's
output does, and its field says so. A positive angle is a counter-clockwise rotation as KiCad shows
it on the front side. Each field states the frame its angle is in.

side.description: The side of its board the footprint is on.

positionMm.description: The footprint anchor `[x, y]`, in that order, in the mount's frame.

footprintName.description: The footprint name, which the mating-axis inference reads. Null when unknown.

pads.description: The pads, in the extractor's order.

courtyard.description: The footprint's courtyard. Null when the footprint has no courtyard graphic.

model.description: Always null: an export's geometry carries no 3D model.

SystemBundleExportGeometry.description:
An export's connector footprint, as the board interface's extractor v6
geometry gives it (millimetres, +y up), without its 3D model.

SystemBundleBoardSide.description: The side of the board a component sits on.

SystemBundleTerminalKind.description: Where a wire of the wire list stops (§16.3).

SystemBundleTightBend.description: A bend tighter than the minimum radius.

at.description: The closest point on the segment.

distanceNm.description: The distance from the curve to the occurrence's box.

neededNm.description: The distance needed: the bundle's radius plus the margin.

SystemBundleClearance.description: Where a segment comes closer to a board or body than its radius and the margin.

SystemBundleFootprintSide.description: The side of its board a footprint is on.

pad.description: The pad number; empty for a mounting or alignment hole.

positionMm.description: The pad centre `[x, y]`, in that order.

sizeMm.description: The pad size `[x, y]`, in that order. Null when the footprint gives none.

shape.description: The pad shape (`circle`, `rect`, …). Null when the footprint gives none.

tht.description: Whether the pad is through-hole. Null when the footprint does not say.

SystemBundleExportPad.description: One pad of an export's footprint geometry, in millimetres in its frame (+y up).

minMm.description: The minimum corner `[x, y]`, in that order.

maxMm.description: The maximum corner `[x, y]`, in that order.

SystemBundleExportCourtyard.description: A footprint's courtyard box in its own frame (+y up), in millimetres.
